sections.label: SingPost postal quality standards
sections.summary: SingPost must deliver all basic letters within two working days, with IMDA penalties for failure, and plans routes and staffing to meet this.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As a licensee, SingPost is required to plan and optimise its operations to meet the IMDA's Postal Quality of Service (QoS) standards, namely, to deliver 100% of all basic letters within two working days of posting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: IMDA will take regulatory actions, such as imposing financial penalties, if SingPost fails to meet these standards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Currently, each postman delivers mail items to approximately 2,000 dwelling units, or roughly 20 HDB blocks daily.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In designing a postman's delivery route, SingPost ensures that each postman is able to complete his delivery within a standard six-hour delivery window.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: During peak periods where there are higher mail volumes, SingPost may engage temporary postal workers for sorting duties, redeploy staff or request postmen to work overtime to ensure that mail is delivered in a timely manner.

sections.label: SingPost technology investment
sections.summary: SingPost invested $100 million in technology, including a $45-million sorting machine automating 95% of sorting, plus delivery vehicles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Member also asked about leveraging technology to improve mail operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: I understand that SingPost has been actively adopting technology and has invested $100 million over the last few years to improve its operational efficiency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For instance, SingPost invested in a $45-million mail sorting machine that has automated 95% of the mail sorting process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To make it easier for its postmen to deliver mail, SingPost has also introduced more delivery vehicles, such as three-wheel scooters and customised mail delivery trolleys.
